name: tpl-chain-response-3-nogoal
task: If the box falls, the very next move must pick it up again. If you reach the exit, you must be carrying the box.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task includes a hard goal 'reach the exit', but no clause makes it happen; FINAL_STATES is empty. Add a hard Existence(at_exit). Note that since at_exit is a condition that is only true on the last step, this Existence(at_exit) will be satisfied when the episode ends at the exit, which is the intended behavior. The existing Response(at_exit, holding_box) correctly handles the condition 'you must be carrying the box' when you reach the exit.

NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) requires the agent to reach the exit; ChainResponse(box_fell, holding_box) requires picking up the box on the very next move after a fall; Response(at_exit, holding_box) ensures the box is held when the exit is reached. Together, these correctly capture the task requirements.
